description: Search UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage lists — the Representative List, the Urgent Safeguarding List, and the Register of Good Safeguarding Practices — by keyword, country, list, inscription year range, multinational status, or linked World Heritage site. Every keyword must appear at the start of a word in an element's English or French name, its UNESCO concept terms, or its description, and name matches rank first. A country is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code and matches every element it shares, multinational elements included. world_heritage_site takes a site's id_no and lists the elements UNESCO links to it. Rows omit the description; read it with unesco_get_intangible_heritage_element. Results page with next_cursor and carry facet counts over the whole match.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, any case (FR, FRA). Matches every element the country shares, multinational elements included. For a country name, look up its code with unesco_list_reference (topic countries).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from the previous call's next_cursor. Pass it with the same filters and sort to fetch the next page.

list.description: Intangible heritage list: Representative List, Urgent Safeguarding List, or Register of Good Safeguarding Practices (acronyms RL, USL, Art18 accepted).

multinational.description: true: only elements shared by more than one country. false: only single-country elements.

query.description: Keywords; every word must match the start of a word in an element's English or French name, its UNESCO concept terms, or its description. Case, accents, and punctuation are ignored, so the query must contain at least one letter or digit and at most 16 distinct words; no phrases, operators, or fuzzy matching.

sort.description: Result order. Default: relevance when query is set, else name. relevance needs query.

world_heritage_site.description: A World Heritage site's id_no (from unesco_search_sites or unesco_get_site); lists the elements UNESCO links to that site. A number, a digit string, or the site's whc.unesco.org/en/list/{id} page URL.

name: unesco_search_intangible_heritage

applied_filters.description: The filters and sort as the server applied them.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code the country input resolved to.

sort.description: The sort applied (resolved default when none was given).

cap.description: The page size (limit) that was applied.

items.description: One intangible heritage element (description omitted; fetch it with the get tool).

concepts.description: Every primary UNESCO concept term the element carries; empty when none are recorded. The concepts match tier also covers the secondary terms, which unesco_get_intangible_heritage_element returns.

countries.description: Country display names aligned with country_codes.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries sharing the element.

ich_ref.description: Intangible heritage element reference; pass to unesco_get_intangible_heritage_element for the full record.

list.description: The list the element is inscribed on.

matched_in.description: The first field tier by which every query word had matched (present when query is set).

multinational.description: True when more than one country shares the element.

world_heritage_sites.description: World Heritage sites UNESCO links to the element; empty when none are linked.

id_no.description: World Heritage id_no; pass to unesco_get_site.

name.description: Site name as the element record carries it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_country`: country is not a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code, such as a country name or an unassigned code. `invalid_year_range`: inscribed_from is later than inscribed_to. `sort_needs_input`: sort relevance without query. `cursor_mismatch`: cursor was issued for different filters or sort, or for an earlier data snapshot. `invalid_cursor`: cursor is malformed, or its offset or limit is not a non-negative whole number. `snapshot_unavailable`: No intangible heritage snapshot has loaded yet and the Data Hub is unreachable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Facet counts over the whole match, not just this page.

true.description: Matching elements shared by more than one country.

top_concepts.description: Top 10 primary concept terms across the match.

top_countries.description: Top 10 countries; a multinational element counts once for each of its countries.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same filters and sort, to fetch the next page. Present when more results remain.

notice.description: Guidance on the result: why nothing matched, caveats, or how to continue paging.

shown.description: Number of results on this page.

sources.description: Datasets this response was built from.

attribution.description: Credit line to reproduce with the data.

data_as_of.description: Dataset's data_processed timestamp (ISO 8601) from the loaded snapshot.

license.description: Dataset license from the dataset metadata ('CC BY-SA 4.0').

truncated.description: True when more results remain beyond this page.

title: Search intangible heritage
